works.title: Creatine and Cognition Article
works.description: Article exploring the cognitive benefits of creatine supplementation for aging adults. Covers dosing strategies, water retention management, cost-benefit analysis of pill versus powder formats, and practical implementation guidance for cognitive support without weight tracking interference.
works.quote: I want to write an article saying that creatine is supposed to be good for cognition as you get older.

works.title: Diklis Chump: Highway to Hell
works.description: Satirical political fiction novel featuring complex characters navigating institutional betrayal and moral compromise in contemporary politics. Uses character-theme integration frameworks to develop ensemble of characters including Secretary of State Marco Polio who represents the archetype of minority betrayal for personal advancement.
works.quote: Execute the Character theme interaction evaluation framework to evaluate the characters in "Diklis Chump: Highway to Hell"
